primary_synthetic.generator: Pinned upstream make_benchmark_controls emission-domain signal and random seeds, adapted only for receipts and process isolation
primary_synthetic.ridge_metric: Per matched group, median over observed ridge points of absolute difference to nearest declared source harmonic at the same receiver time. No interpolation over missing observations.

extensions.scope: Separate semantic controls adapted from pinned discovery unit tests; the weak partial event has no promised discovery sensitivity.

real_corpus.input_encoding: 192 kbps MP3, stripped metadata, opaque sequential filename
real_corpus.limitation: The corpus comprises published aircraft-positive clips. Without independent event time labels tied to audio sample zero, proposal counts are descriptive and cannot establish event precision/recall. Upstream proposals are never truth. Technical execution success does not mean all aircraft were detected.

evaluation_separation: Generate/save labels before native execution; pass only audio paths; load labels after all corresponding predictions complete. Procedural isolation on one filesystem, not an inaccessible holdout.
failure_policy: Missing, malformed, duplicate or failed cases remain failures; no silent skipping or threshold adjustment. Public deterministic synthetic controls are software regressions, not independent real accuracy.
